descriptions.capability.list: Read registered actions and components. Does not start R or a Core Host.
descriptions.document.read: Read the shared acknowledged buffer, including unsaved text and its version.
descriptions.document.edit: Apply conditional UTF-16 text edits to the shared buffer; keep the returned version.
descriptions.action.submit: Execute the explicitly selected project R script snapshot and requirements. Persist operationId before delivery; identical retries retain the original Core identity. Output directory is the first R argument, followed by explicit args or frozen resource paths. Artifact paths are output-relative; completion is run-directory-relative, returned as plan.completion, so an inventory can remain beside immutable producer artifacts.
descriptions.action.lookup: Read the original accepted operation. Missing acknowledgement is not permission for a new identity.
descriptions.action.observe: Observe original Core facts. Never starts or recovers a Host.
descriptions.context.read: Read an explicit versioned context package. Receipt establishes a tool fetch, not proactive delivery to a conversation.
descriptions.binding.open: Bind this external session to the authenticated project scope. Conversation stays in Claude Code.
descriptions.capability.configure: Persist the selected project plugins with a conditional version and idempotent changeId. This changes routing only; it installs no package, starts no runtime and cancels no work.
descriptions.skill.list: List the application and enabled provider Skills shipped in the selected package. Skills guide discovery but do not grant authorization.
descriptions.skill.read: Read one versioned shipped Skill after checking its digest. A stale digest requires rereading instead of applying cached instructions.
descriptions.resource.register: Declare scoped existing bytes and their type/schema at the supplied digest. This read and registration starts no runtime.
descriptions.requirements.check: Probe only the explicitly declared R packages with bounded base R; no Core Host or project script starts.
descriptions.data.compare: Join two explicit table versions using declared keys, namespaces, fields and join policy. Scientific comparability remains the project responsibility.
descriptions.object.read: Read a bounded exported JSON object snapshot, not live R memory.
descriptions.artifact.check: Verify the selected completion inventory and file bytes only; domain check reports remain project resources.

compatibility: Major API path changes for incompatible fields/semantics; additive optional fields allowed. Per-resource versions are independent.
legacy: v1 schemas and captured fixtures are frozen. Legacy reads and explicit retry/cancel of accepted requests remain available; new recipe submissions require an explicit v2 project script.
